name: Dev Pramoth
description: Building in crypto since 2018: led Ocean Protocol's $7M token launch, shipped crypto trading at Trade Republic to 1M+ users, and was first PM at Unstoppable Finance, launching Ultimate, a self-custodial wallet acquired by Jupiter. Now Product Lead at Safe, building onchain policy and role-based execution for the smart account infrastructure securing $100B+. Seven years in, still convinced self-custody is the point.
